description: This file defines the InputLayoutCache class responsible for building and caching Direct3D 11 input layouts within the ANGLE project. It includes methods for managing input layout creation, cache management, and handling vertex attribute configurations.

classes.name: PackedAttributeLayout
classes.description: A class representing the layout of vertex attributes, including methods to add attribute data and compare layouts.

classes.name: InputLayoutCache
classes.description: A class that manages caching of D3D11 input layouts to optimize rendering performance.

methods.name: addAttributeData
methods.description: Adds attribute data to the layout, encoding type, semantic index, format, and divisor.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Compares two PackedAttributeLayout instances for equality.

methods.name: getInputLayout
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an input layout based on current vertex attributes and state.

methods.name: createInputLayout
methods.description: Creates a new D3D11 input layout object based on vertex attribute descriptions and shader data.

methods.name: setCacheSize
methods.description: Sets a new size for the input layout cache, resetting it.
